question: What minimum off-roadway sizes does Table 9A-1 give for a STOP sign, a YIELD sign, and a Crossbuck sign on a bicycle facility?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For signs installed on bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths ("Off Roadway" column of Table 9A-1), the minimum sizes are 18 x 18 inches for the STOP (R1-1) sign, 18 x 18 x 18 inches for the YIELD (R1-2) sign, and 24 x 4.5 inches for the Grade Crossing (Crossbuck, R15-1) sign. Use of these minimum sizes for bicyclist-specific installations is a mandatory requirement. Standards (mandatory): - "The minimum sign and plaque sizes for signs specific to bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths shall be those shown in Table 9A-1. These sizes shall be used only for signs and plaques installed specifically for bicyclist applications." - For temporary traffic control: "The minimum TTC sign and plaque sizes for shared-use paths shall conform to those shown in Table 9A-1." Visual evidence: - [Image 8] Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1 of 3) lists "Stop, R1-1, 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18"; "Yield, R1-2, 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18 x 18"; and "Grade Crossing (Crossbuck), R15-1, 9B.23, Off Roadway 24 x 4.5" (with a Roadway size of 48 x 9). - [Image 6] Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 2 of 2) illustrates the Crossbuck (R15-1) sign among regulatory signs for bicycle facilities. - [Image 7] Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 1 of 2) illustrates the STOP (R1-1) and YIELD (R1-2) signs as regulatory signs for bicycle facilities. Citations: - Section 9A.02 Standard §10 (p.1048) - Section 6N.04 Standard §19 (p.844) - Section 9A.03 Guidance §3 (p.1051) - Table 9A-1 (p.1036) - Page 1090
gold_answer: STOP: 18 x 18 inches; YIELD: 18 x 18 x 18 inches; Crossbuck: 24 x 4.5 inches.
